quiz.question: What are the three rules of the Box Constraint Model?

answers.answer: Constraints go down, sizes go up, parent sets position
Sizes go down, constraints go up, child sets position
Parent sets size, child sets position, constraints go down

quiz.question: What is the initial constraint for the widget at the top of the widget tree?

answers.answer: The entire screen of the device

quiz.question: When does the Box Constraint Model not work?

answers.answer: When the screen is too small
When the parent doesn't know the constraints
